verdict.rationale: Nix's own docs cover the core of this story. `nix-shell` and `nix develop` build or download a project's declared dependencies and drop you into a shell with them set. Flakes live in and build from the current project directory, and multiple versions of a package can coexist. Nix is also pitched as reproducible, shareable per-project development environments. Community users confirm it handles multi-language projects with conflicting dependency versions where virtualenv-style tools fail. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a checked-in shell.nix/flake.nix pinning specific runtime versions (e.g. a particular Python or Node), automatic environment switching when changing directories, and independent hands-on walkthroughs of per-project version switching.
